messages.author: 6f70112da710c9b5
messages.subject: Bifactor model and structural model
parts:
Hi,

I have a doubt about how to interpret CFA bifactor model when the hierarchycal omega for the second level factor is below 0,7. Does it mean that I have to use in structural only its subscales or first level factor?

Thanks in advance.

David Vilariño
Universidad de Jaén
Spain

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Bifactor model and structural model
parts:
How much lower from 0.7? This 0.7 is a common practice sutoff, but there is no strong evidence of it being a good cutpoint for every application.
You should consider multiple information to make this decision: factor loadings, model fit, modification indices, R2 ...
